capabilities: Chat with AI using selected Canvas node content as context
Generate images from prompts as Canvas image nodes
Generate mind-map style answer nodes on the Canvas
Edit note text with diff-reviewed AI suggestions in a sidebar
disambiguation: Not limited to Canvas; it also provides a sidebar AI co-pilot and floating editing for regular Markdown notes.
extras: Available only via manual installation from GitHub releases, not yet in the community plugin store. Conversations are sent to third-party APIs; the author disclaims liability for generated content and API costs.
motivation: The README says the plugin started as Canvas AI enhancement and grew into a general Obsidian AI assistant with context awareness of nodes and selections.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to use AI models contextually inside Canvas boards or note editing workflows.

relations.evidence: 深度集成了 Gemini / OpenAI / Antigravity 等先进 AI 模型
支持 Gemini (Google), OpenRouter 等多种 API 提供商
类似 Google Gemini Canvas 的侧边栏体验

requires.name: Gemini, OpenRouter or OpenAI-compatible API key
third-party API provider account (e.g. OpenRouter, yunwu, gptgod)
API usage fees charged by the provider

summary: AI assistant plugin that chats with selected Canvas nodes, generates text, mind-map nodes and images, and edits Markdown notes via a sidebar co-pilot.
